stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seeds=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    dd=collections.defaultdict(list); ad=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for i,j,c in seeds:
        dd[i-j].append((i,j)); ad[i+j].append((i,j))
    covered=set()
    def segfill(D,name):
        for k2,pl in D.items():
            pl=sorted(pl,key=lambda p:p[0])
            cols={g[i][j] for i,j in pl}
            if len(pl)>=2 and len(cols)==1:
                i0,j0=pl[0]; i1,j1=pl[-1]
                if name=='d' and (i1-i0)!=j1-j0: continue
                if name=='a' and (i1-i0)!=(j1-j0): continue
                c=g[i0][j0]
                for i in range(i0,i1+1):
                    j=i-k2 if name=='d' else k2-i
                    if 0<=j<w:
                        covered.add((i,j))
                        if out[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=c
    segfill(dd,'d'); segfill(ad,'a')
    for x,y,c in seeds:
        if (x,y) in covered: continue
        for di,dj in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
            ii,jj=x+di,y+dj
            while 0<=ii<h and 0<=jj<w:
                if out[ii][jj]==bg: out[ii][jj]=c
                ii+=di; jj+=dj
    return out

G=load()
def solve(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seeds=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    dd=collections.defaultdict(list); ad=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for i,j,c in seeds:
        dd[i-j].append((i,j)); ad[i+j].append((i,j))
    def fill(D,nm):
        for pl in D.values():
            bycol=collections.defaultdict(list)
            for p,z in pl: bycol[z].append(p)
            for c,pcs in bycol.items():
                pcs=sorted(pcs)
                if len(pcs)<2: continue
                i0,j0=pcs[0]; i1,j1=pcs[-1]
                if nm=='d' and i1-i0!=j1-j0: continue
                if nm=='a' and i1-i0!=(w-1-(j1-j0)): continue
                step=1 if i1>i0 else -1
                for i in range(i0,i1+step,h*2):
                    pass
                for idx in range(len(pcs)-1):
                    i,a=pics=pcs[idx]; b=pcs[idx+1]
                    # paint cells strictly between on the line
                    jj=0
                    di,dj=(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])
                    import math
                    L=math.gcd(abs(di),abs(dj)) or 1
                    for t in range(1,L):
                        ti, tj=a[0]+di*t//L, a[1]+dj*t//L
                        if 0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w and out[ti][tj]==bg: out[ti][tj]=c
    fill(dd,'d'); fill(ad,'a')

def solve(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seeds=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    dd=collections.defaultdict(list); ad=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for i,j,c in seeds:
        dd[i-j].append((i,j,c)); ad[i+j].append((i,j,c))
    def fill(D,nm):
        for k2,pl in D.items():
            bycol=collections.defaultdict(list)
            for item in pl: bycol[item[2]].append(item[:2])
            for c,pcs in bycol.items():
                if len(pcs)<2: continue
                s=sorted(pcs); a,b=s[0],s[-1]
                di,dj=b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]
                if nm=='d' and di!=dj: continue
                if nm=='a' and di!=-dj: continue
                L=max(abs(di),abs(dj))
                st=1 if di>0 else -1
                d=(st,st) if nm=='d' else (st,-st)
                for t in range(1,L+1):
                    ti,tj=a[0]+d[0]*t,a[1]+d[1]*t
                    if 0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w and out[ti][tj]==bg: out[ti][tj]=c
    for D,nm in [(dd,'d'),(ad,'a')]: fill(D,nm)
    cnt=collections.Counter(c for _,_,c in seeds)
    # singleton inside a pair's span -> extend perpendicular; check which diagonal the pair lies on and whether singleton is on/near that line
    single=[p for p in seeds if cnt[p[2]]==1]
    for ip in single:
        i,j,cl=ip
        # find pair lines sharing this diagonal and check if ip lies between the extremes (inclusive-ish)
        for D,nm in [(dd,'d'),(ad,'a')]:
            pl=D.get(i-j) or D.get(i+j)
            if pl is None: continue
            others=[x for x in pl if x[2]!=cl]
            if len(others)>=2:
                s=sorted([x[:2] for x in others]); a,b=s[0],s[-1]
                # ip must be collinear with others on this diagonal (already true since same k2) and within span
                if a[0]<=i<=b[0]:
                    # extend perpendicular through ip
                    perps=[(1,-1),(-1,1)] if nm=='d' else [(1,1),(-1,-1)]
                    for d0,d1 in perps:
                        t=1
                        while True:
                            ti,tj=i+d0*t,j+d1*t
                            if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): break
                            if out[ti][tj]==bg: out[ti][tj]=cl
                            t+=1
                    break
    return out

def solve2(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=max(set(sum(g,[])),key=lambda v:sum(r_.count(v) for r_ in g))
    pts=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    out=[r_[:] for r_ in g]
    def paint(k2,isanti):
        cells=[(i,j,c) for i,j,c in pts if (isanti or i-j==k2) and (not isanti or i+j!=None)]
        # only cells whose diagonal key matches
        cells=[(i,j,c) for i,j,c in pts if k2 is None or ('a' if isanti else 'd')=='a' is False and (i-j==k2 if isanti is False else i+j==k2)]
        if len(cells)<2: return
        cs=set(c for _,_,c in cells)
        if len(cs)>1: return
        c=next(iter(cs))
        s=sorted((i,j) for i,j,_ in cells)
        step=(1,-1) if isanti else (1,1)
        for a,b in zip(s,s[1:]):
            t=1
            while True:
                ti,tj=a[0]+step[0]*t,a[1]+step[1]*t
                if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): break
                if out[ti][tj]==bg: out[ti][tj]=c
                t+=1
    keysD=set(i-j for i,j,c in pts); keysS=set(i+j for i,j,c in pts)
    for k2 in keysD: paint(k2,False)
    for k2 in keysS: paint(k2,True)
    return out

def solve3(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=max(set(sum(g,[])),key=lambda v:sum(r_.count(v) for r_ in g))
    pts=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    out=[r_[:] for r_ in g]
    dd=collections.defaultdict(list); sd=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for i,j,c in pts:
        dd[i-j].append((i,j,c)); sd[i+j].append((i,j,c))
    # multi-color keys: dominant color paints between extremes, keeping others; perpendicular single-color lines from anchors
    for D,nm in [(dd,'d'),(sd,'a')]:
        for k2,pl in list(D.items()):
            byc=collections.defaultdict(list)
            for i,j,c in pl: byc[c].append((i,j))
            colors=list(byc)
            if len(colors)==1:
                c0=colors[0]; pcs=sorted(byc[c0])
                step=(1,1) if nm=='d' else (1,-1)
                t=1
                while True:
                    ti,tj=pcs[0][0]+step[0]*t,pcs[0][1]+step[1]*t
                    if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): break
                    if out[ti][tj]==bg: out[ti][tj]=c0
                    t+=1
                t=1
                while True:
                    ti,tj=pcs[-1][0]-step[0]*t,pcs[-1][1]-step[1]*t
                    if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): break
                    if out[ti][tj]==bg: out[ti][tj]=c0
                    t+=1
            else:
                dom=max(byc,key=lambda c:len(byc[c]))
                pc=sorted(byc[dom]); oc=[c for c in byc if c!=dom]
                step=(1,1) if nm=='d' else (1,-1)
                t=1
                while True:
                    ti,tj=pc[0][0]+step[0]*t,pc[0][1]+step[1]*t
                    if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): break
                    if out[ti][tj]==bg: out[ti][tj]=dom
                    t+=1
                t=1
                while True:
                    ti,tj=pc[-1][0]-step[0]*t,pc[-1][1]-step[1]*t
                    if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): break
                    if out[ti][tj]==bg: out[ti][tj]=dom
                    t+=1
    return out

def solve(g):

    out=[r_[:] for r_ in g]
    dd=collections.defaultdict(list); sd=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for i,j,c in pts:
        dd[i-j].append((i,j,c)); sd[i+j].append((i,j,c))
    D={**dd,**sd}; keys=['D','S']
    def handle(pl,keyname,step,anti):
        byc=collections.defaultdict(list)
        for i,j,c in pl: byc[c].append((i,j))
        for c,pcs in byc.items():
            s=sorted(pcs)
            if len(s)<2: continue
            # interior markers of other colors on this diagonal segment
            inter=[p for p in pl if s[0][0]<=p[0]<=s[-1][0] and s[0][1]<=p[1]<=s[-1][1]]
            # collect all non-bg cells strictly between consecutive extreme cells
            inner=[p for p in pl if not (p==s[0] or p==s[-1])]
            if inner and any(c2!=c for _,_,c2 in inner):
                # intruder -> no fill; instead extend the unique intruder color(s) perpendicular

            for a,b in zip(s,s[1:]):
                t=1
                while True:
                    ti,tj=a[0]+step[0]*t,a[1]+step[1]*t
                    if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): break
                    if out[ti][tj]==bg: out[ti][tj]=c
                    t+=1
    def intruder_ext(pl,s):
        # find intruder cells: non-bg, between extremes, color != majority color c
        dom=collections.Counter(c for _,_,c in pl)

        for i,j,c2 in pl:

            # perpendicular diagonal through (i,j): main diag i-j
            perp=i-j
            t=1

                if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): break

            while True:

                if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): break
                if out[ti][tj]==bg: out[ti][tj]=c2

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=max(set(sum(g,[])),key=lambda v:sum(r_.count(v) for r_ in g))
    pts=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    out=[r_[:] for r_ in g]
    byc=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for i,j,c in pts: byc[c].append((i,j))
    def seg(p,q):
        di,dj=q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]
        if abs(di)!=abs(dj) or di==0 or dj==0: return None
        s=(1,1) if (di>0)==(dj>0) else (1,-1)
        t=1
        while True:
            ti,tj=p[0]+s[0]*t,p[1]+s[1]*t
            if (ti,tj)==q: return s
            if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): return None
            t+=1
    for c,ps in byc.items():
        for p,q in itertools.combinations(ps,2):
            s=seg(p,q)
            if s is None: continue
            inter=[]; t=1
            while True:
                ti,tj=p[0]+s[0]*t,p[1]+s[1]*t
                if (ti,tj)==q: break
                inter.append((ti,tj)); t+=1
            intr=[(a,b,out[a][b]) for a,b in inter if out[a][b]!=bg and out[a][b]!=c]
            for a,b in inter:
                if out[a][b]==bg: out[a][b]=c
            for a,b,iv in intr:
                perp=((1,1) if s==(1,-1) else (1,-1))
                for st in (perp,(-perp[0],-perp[1])):
                    t=1
                    while True:
                        ti,tj=a+st[0]*t,b+st[1]*t
                        if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): break
                        if out[ti][tj]==bg: out[ti][tj]=iv
                        t+=1
    return out

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=max(set(sum(g,[])),key=lambda v:sum(r_.count(v) for r_ in g))
    pts=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    out=[r_[:] for r_ in g]
    def seg(p,q):
        di,dj=q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]
        if abs(di)!=abs(dj) or di==0 or dj==0: return None
        s=(1,1) if (di>0)==(dj>0) else (1,-1)
        t=1
        while True:
            ti,tj=p[0]+s[0]*t,p[1]+s[1]*t
            if (ti,tj)==q: return s
            if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): return None
            t+=1
    byc=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for i,j,c in pts: byc[c].append((i,j))
    for c,ps in byc.items():
        for p,q in itertools.combinations(sorted(ps),2):
            d=seg(p,q)
            if d is None: continue
            inter=[]; t=1
            while True:
                ti,tj=p[0]+d[0]*t,p[1]+d[1]*t
                if (ti,tj)==q: break
                inter.append((ti,tj)); t+=1
            # interior non-bg values in INPUT
            intr=[(a,b,g[a][b]) for a,b in inter if g[a][b]!=bg and g[a][b]!=c]
            for a,b in inter:
                if out[a][b]==bg: out[a][b]=c
            if intr:
                perp=((1,-1) if d==(1,1) else (1,1))
                for a,b,iv in intr:
                    for st in (perp,(-perp[0],-perp[1])):
                        t=1
                        while True:
                            ti,tj=a+st[0]*t,b+st[1]*t
                            if not(0<=ti<h and 0<=tj<w): break
                            if out[ti][tj]==bg: out[ti][tj]=iv
                            t+=1
    return out
